messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick thread — planning the email series for the new performance benchmark post + webinar on May 12. want to lock segmentation, subject lines, and follow-up routing. :calendar:
Oliver (Growth): agree. high-level plan: 1) announce blog + highlights, 2) webinar invite (with speakers + agenda), 3) follow-up w/ recording + demo CTA. frequency: 3 sends over 10 days. :rocket:
Sara (Content): working on short copy. draft subject options for A/B:
- A: "Redwood benchmark: 3x faster LLM inference, real numbers"
- B: "See the latency & cost wins from our latest benchmarks"
Also a softer version for trials: "How we cut per-token cost — benchmarks + webinar"
Alex (Growth): timing thoughts — send 1st email Tue AM PT, invite Thu AM PT, follow-up Tue AM PT. timezone-optimize for recipients >50% in EU (send +8h).
Oliver (Growth): segmentation proposal: target currently-active hosted API customers + trials started in last 90 days + anyone with >100k tokens/mo. who should we exclude? churned accounts?
Maya (Marketing): exclude demo-only accounts and customers flagged for custom enterprise outreach. also want small drip for mid-market: different CTA (book 1:1 vs join webinar).
Oliver (Growth): here's the SQL we'll use for the main segment (will run in growth-db):
```
SELECT user_id, email
FROM users
WHERE (plan IN ('hosted','dedicated') OR trial = true)
  AND tokens_last_30d > 100000
  AND status = 'active'
  AND NOT tags LIKE '%enterprise-manual%';
```
Sara (Content): subject lines for webinar invite:
- "Live: Benchmark walkthrough + cost-saving tactics (May 12)"
- "Bring your questions — LLM inference benchmarks & Q&A"
Also a short preview line: "Join us for a 30-min walkthrough + live Q&A"
Jenna (CS): who triages inbound leads from webinar signups? recommend Sales-Ops tag leads as `webinar_bench_may` and route to AE queue for hosted/dedicated depending on current plan. I can own the routing if we confirm tags.
Maya (Marketing): perfect — Jenna please own routing. Oliver, can you add the tag mapping to the automation doc? :+1:
Oliver (Growth): will do. also propose A/B test the CTA in follow-up (recording -> "Request a demo" vs "Run a cost model for my team").
Alex (Growth): we should also include a short one-click feedback pulse in the follow-up: 1-5 stars for usefulness. metric: % click to demo.
Maya (Marketing): assign tasks:
- Sara: finalize copy + A/B subject lines by Fri EOD
- Oliver: implement segments + automation mapping by Mon
- Jenna: confirm routing + AE queue by Mon
- Alex: set up timezone sends + pulse metric in send config
calendar-bot: Event created: "Benchmarks + Webinar: May 12" — invites sent to marketing, growth, cs. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/benchmarks-webinar-may12
Sara (Content): will share draft in #marketing-drafts. expect first versions by Thu for review. :memo:
Maya (Marketing): perfect. one more ask — include a short benchmark one-pager attachment in the webinar invite email. Sara, can you produce a 1-page PDF with 3 highlight charts?
Sara (Content): yep, I can. need raw charts from research team — @oliver can you collect and drop assets in /shared/benchmarks?
Oliver (Growth): on it. dumping assets by EOD tomorrow. :file_folder:
Jenna (CS): once leads flow in, I'll confirm routing works and post a short report in this thread with counts.
Maya (Marketing): awesome. thanks team! next sync if any blocker. :sparkles:
